name: delay_pingpong_send
description: Ping-pong delay send — alternating L/R echoes, wide stereo effect
notes: 200ms ping-pong at feedback 0.45: fills the stereo field without muddying the mono center. Send mode outputs wet-only — route this to a return bus and blend to taste. LP at 5kHz prevents high-frequency buildup on feedback tails. Typical send level: -6 to -12 dB on the return fader.
